text:
alex: Quick design review — trying to reconcile streaming UI with a compact token indicator and the prompt library insert flow. dropping a few loose ideas.
priya: love it. can we define 'stop' vs 'pause' first? customers keep confusing stop->can't resume.
marco: my vote: 'Pause stream' (temporary) + 'Stop & commit' (final). the regen button should live near the message actions, not in the header.
sam: agree on semantics. also token counter: should it track live token usage for the whole conversation or per-response?
jen: per-response is easier to reason about for authors. show total convo tokens in the side rail.
alex: thinking micro copy: for the single response button, label as "Pause" (tooltip: "pause streaming — you can resume") and a secondary "Stop & Regenerate" (tooltip: "stop and re-run from prompt").
priya: accessibility nit: both buttons need clear aria-labels. example:

```html
<button aria-label="Pause streaming response" title="Pause streaming response">Pause</button>
<button aria-label="Stop and regenerate response" title="Stop and regenerate response">Stop & Regenerate</button>
```

this keeps screenreader text explicit.
marco: spacing: if we put both buttons inline with a token-pill it gets cramped on narrow viewports. maybe collapse into an overflow menu on < 520px.
sam: + keyboard shortcuts. `Esc` to pause, `Cmd+R` to regenerate (with prompt to confirm if large token cost).
jen: token pill copy: show two numbers: "resp: 124 tok | convo: 6.3k tok". small label text helps first-time users.
alex: streaming visual: show a faint shimmer for uncommitted text + a solid final state when stream completes. shimmer must not be used for screen readers (should be aria-hidden).
ui-bot: design-check: contrast of token pill is 3.8:1 currently — fails small text ratio. consider darker bg or bolder text.
priya: yes. also colorblindness: use a shape + color, not color alone, for streaming state. e.g., green dot + pulse.
marco: prompt library insertion: current flow is drag/drop or copy — users expect Quick Insert button on each snippet.
jen: Quick Insert should preview prompt variables inline before inserting. small inline form: fields auto-filled from last convo context.
sam: UX edge-case: if user inserts a prompt while streaming, what happens? proposal: show a transient banner: "New prompt will cancel current response — continue? [Cancel][Insert]".
alex: proposes A/B test 1: (A) regen button in message actions; (B) regen in top bar. Metric: % accidental regens and time-to-regenerate.
priya: A/B test 2: (A) token pill per-response only; (B) both per-response + convo. Metric: errors due to token exhaustion + support tickets.
marco: implementation question: should token calculation be optimistic (estimate while streaming) or conservative? conservative avoids last-minute surprises.
jen: developer note — front-end will subscribe to partial token counts from the streaming endpoint: `partial_token_count` event. we should send events sparingly to avoid noise.

alex: small copy tweak for empty prompt library state: "No saved prompts yet — use Quick Insert to add common replies." instead of "You have no prompts".
priya: love that. also add an inline CTA: "Import from examples".
sam: deployment note: rolling this in two phases: 1) accessibility + keyboard shortcuts, 2) compact layout + prompt quick-insert. deploy bot will post when ready.
ui-bot: deploy-signal: design spec v3 uploaded: https://redwood/specs/playground/stream-ux/v3
alex: thanks all — I'll consolidate these and update Figma. next: can someone take the action to prototype the compact token pill and overflow menu? @marco?
marco: on it, will push a quick prototype by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
jen: I'll wire up the aria labels and keyboard handlers once prototype lands.
priya: I'll write the copy and the microcopy QA checklist.
alex: perfect — closing thread for now. feel free to reply with quick screenshots or gifs in follow-ups.
